scheme.label: Claude Code terms
scheme.description: The things every Claude Code set-up has, named as Claude Code's documentation names them.

concepts.definition: The Markdown file in which a person or a project gives Claude Code standing instructions. Claude Code reads it at the start of every session.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A Markdown file in the rules folder of the Claude folder or a project. Claude Code loads it, optionally only when it opens a file that matches the paths listed in the file.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A folder with a SKILL.md file that teaches Claude Code a task. Claude Code loads the skill when the task matches its description or when the person invokes it.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A Markdown file in the agents folder that defines a specialised assistant with its own instructions, tools and model. Claude Code hands tasks to it and it works in its own context.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A command that Claude Code runs at a set point in its work, such as before a tool runs or when a session ends. Hooks are set in settings.json.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: The notes that Claude Code keeps between sessions in a memory folder of each project, indexed by MEMORY.md.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: The JSON file in which Claude Code holds permissions, hooks, environment variables and other options.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A Markdown file that changes how Claude Code writes its replies, chosen by the person.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A command that a person types after a slash to start a stored prompt or an action in Claude Code.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A program that gives Claude Code extra tools and data through the Model Context Protocol.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)

concepts.definition: A kind of work, such as writing code or reviewing code, that the app joins to the routes that start it and to the files to read first.
concepts.decided_by: Starting vocabulary, which follows Claude Code's own documentation (6 October 2026)
